### 1. Summary of the Purpose:
The purpose of the paper is to investigate the electronic structure of the uranium dinitride (UN₂) molecule using a combination of anion photoelectron spectroscopy and relativistic coupled-cluster computational methods. The study specifically focuses on characterizing the electron affinity, excited state energy levels, and the structural changes (bending and U-N bond elongation) that occur upon electron attachment and electronic excitation. Additionally, the paper discusses the implications of these findings for the activation of UN₂.
